# ZXing browser

`zxing-browser.min.js` is the unmodified UMD bundle of **@zxing/browser 0.1.5**.

- Source: https://github.com/zxing-js/browser
- Download: https://unpkg.com/@zxing/browser@0.1.5/umd/zxing-browser.min.js
- License: MIT, preserved in `ZXING-LICENSE`.
- SHA-256: `b5ad3df920738ca7adcb74508d7e6b6a5b9024993fb9a0c702da1ad8964eca07`

No CDN is needed at runtime. The service worker caches this local file for offline shell use. Food lookups still require a network connection.
